<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the signals in the typical aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are: 143.10, 139.03, 135.88, 129.50 (twice), 129.01 (twice), 128.90 (twice), 128.50 (twice), and 127.20. Counting each occurrence gives 12 aromatic carbon signals, indicating 12 aromatic carbons in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>12</final_answer>
